corrections.label: Under the Wave off Kanagawa
corrections.previous_card: Hokusai’s Under the Wave off Kanagawa places a small Mount Fuji within the curve of a much larger wave. Indigo and imported Prussian blue help shape the print’s visual relationships. Comparing mountain and water reveals a composition organized through striking differences in scale and framing.
corrections.corrected_card: Hokusai’s Under the Wave off Kanagawa makes Mount Fuji appear as a small triangular form within a towering wave. The contrast depends on perspective and framing. Looking between the mountain and the water reveals how the print organizes apparently unequal scales within one view.
corrections.reason: Removed the print-specific pigment claim because the inspected paragraph states the artist’s broader landscape palette; the revised card confines itself to this print’s documented composition.

corrections.label: Photographs of British Algae
corrections.previous_card: Anna Atkins’s Photographs of British Algae arranged specimens directly on sensitized paper to make cyanotype images. Botanical names accompanied the delicate traces. The project brings scientific identification together with the visual decisions involved in placing an individual plant against the blue photographic field.
corrections.corrected_card: Anna Atkins’s Photographs of British Algae arranged specimens directly on sensitized paper to make cyanotype images. Botanical names accompanied the delicate traces. corrections.reason: Uses specimen rather than a potentially misleading botanical classification; no claim that every copy contains an identical set of images.
